title: Rosemary Beach "The Sanctuary" 18 New Providence Lane Carriage House

description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Carriage house- Located South of 30A- Short walk to the beach- Access to 4 neighborhood pools- Access to fitness center and racquet club- Professionally decorated- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: The Sanctuary is a south-of-30A 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom Rosemary Beach Carriage House that sleeps 4. Guests will love the quick walk to the beach, the convenience of nearby dining, shopping, and access to 4 community pools.Guests step into a comfortable open living area and kitchen. Hardwood floors, an eye-catching driftwood chandelier, and a hanging barn door make the cozy space feel more substantial. A queen sleeper sofa and chairs face a TV, and a full kitchen has a dine-in island that seats 3. The bedroom is separated from the living area by the barn door.Guests can easily explore Rosemary Beach on 2 included adult bikes. The Racquet Club, 4 community pools, restaurants, shopping, and a fitness center are all within short walking distance from The Sanctuary. With its south-of-30A location, The Sanctuary will book quickly. Secure your next 30A beach escape today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 4):CARRIAGE HOUSE:-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Living Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa*Your rental property may share a lot with the main house that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party. Unfortunately, the courtyard and private pool are for the main house only.*This rental is not pet-friendly.
